import os

def collect_corpus():
    target_dir = "scripts/rag_corpus"
    os.makedirs(target_dir, exist_ok=True)
    
    documents = {
        "rag_overview.md": "# RAG Overview\nRetrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) combines generative LLMs with external knowledge retrieval to reduce hallucinations.",
        "vector_db_guide.md": "# Vector DB Guide\nVector databases store embeddings to enable semantic search via cosine similarity or Euclidean distance.",
        "prompt_engineering.md": "# Prompt Engineering\nEffective prompting involves few-shot examples, chain-of-thought reasoning, and clear constraints."
    }
    
    count = 0
    for filename, content in documents.items():
        file_path = os.path.join(target_dir, filename)
        with open(file_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(content)
        count += 1
    
    print(f"Successfully collected {count} documents to {target_dir}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    collect_corpus()

[RUN] python3 scripts/collect_rag_corpus.py
[RESULT_CHECK] 命令输出包含 "Successfully collected 3 documents" 且 scripts/rag_corpus/ 目录下存在 3 个文件
